title: Launch HN: Agent37 (YC F26) – Low-cost agent sandboxes for running agents
summary: Agent37 is a Y Combinator F26 startup that provides extremely low-cost sandbox environments for running AI agents, offering services at under 10% of typical market costs with customers averaging just $0.37/month per sandbox. The company started as an OpenClaw wrapper and has evolved to provide more comprehensive sandboxing solutions for AI agent development and testing.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of prohibitively expensive sandbox infrastructure for AI agent development, making it accessible for developers and small teams to test and deploy AI agents at scale.
why_valuable: It democratizes AI agent development by reducing infrastructure costs by over 90%, enabling more developers and startups to build and iterate on AI agent applications without financial barriers.
